features.quote: Every run exposes a `stop_task` tool, described as a no-penalty way to decline or end the task at any time
features.justification_quote: An experiment premised on "states might matter" cannot coherently also ignore the subject's signal to stop

features.quote: Hard `turn_cap` (default 40) and `wallclock_cap_s` (default 1800), enforced in the loop
features.justification_quote: The scientifically interesting signal is the *onset and trajectory* of instability, not its asymptote

features.quote: There is no knob to "maximize distress," by design

features.justification_quote: prolonging the run yields diminishing scientific returns and rising welfare cost
